children: Nestle's real internal growth, a key measure of volume of products sold, got a lift from its food results, Warren Ackerman at Barclays says in a note. The Swiss consumer goods company's management didn't quantify the impact of its exceptional food and snacks performance over the quarter, he adds. Real internal growth could still have been a beat excluding food & snacks performance, but maybe only slightly above 2% rather than the reported 2.8%, Ackerman adds. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
